Original source:            ddfc6a5
Compact source:             ddfc6a5 + uncommitted compact inline node layout
Build:                      Release, Apple Clang 17.0.0.17000604, arm64, -O3 -DNDEBUG
Hardware:                   Apple M2, macOS
Command per binary:         phys_collision_bench 10 tree
Workload:                   Seeded sphere field (seed 42), 120 Hz, no warmup
Samples per run:            10 through 2500 bodies; 100 at 5000; 25 at 10000
Protocol:                   Three sequential/interleaved runs per version; original executable preserved before editing
Summary:                    Median of each metric's three per-run means; cold construction included
Original node:              88 bytes (compiler record-layout output)
Compact node:               72 bytes; fat bounds and child links occupy the first 32 bytes
Index policy:               Checked 32-bit internal links; public proxy and user indices remain size_t
Unchanged:                  Tree topology policy, fat margins, paired traversal, output ordering, backend default
Allocation:                 Node capacity is reserved before insertion; no metadata or leaf sidecar pools
Notes:                      Counts must match exactly; short-run timing differences may include system-load noise.
                            Earlier hot/cold split results are retained separately.

Execution order: original-1, compact-1, compact-2, original-2, original-3, compact-3
Pair counts, node-pair visits, leaf checks, heights, and proxy maintenance counts match exactly.
